scope: Nine public page templates in English and Chinese; shared navigation/footer manually reviewed. Design explorations, source documents, and concurrent Three.js hero implementation excluded.
method: Unslop default two-pass rewrite: read source, diagnose exact spans, repair only confirmed findings, then validate. English metrics are candidates, not proof of authorship. Chinese reviewed manually.

edits.before: Support that can keep producing value.
edits.reason: Value does not identify the outcomes. The section names reusable competition outputs and links to the post-event plan.

edits.before: 让投入持续沉淀为公共成果。
edits.after: 支持可复用的赛后公共成果。
edits.reason: 投资沉淀 does not explain the support. The section describes reusable public outputs after the event.

edits.before: A sequence that continues after the last team.
edits.after: Work planned after all teams finish.
edits.reason: Sequence does not identify the work, and last team omits completion. The source specifies a work plan after all teams finish.

edits.before: 从最后一队完成比赛开始，继续推进。
edits.after: 全部队伍完赛后的工作安排。
edits.reason: 继续推进 leaves the object unstated. The heading introduces the post-event work schedule.

edits.before: Connect user experience and technical capability.
edits.after: Study user experience and technical capability.
edits.reason: Connect does not identify the research action. The section lists evaluation research and joint experiments; the existing Chinese wording already states this clearly.

edits.before: Evidence that can become public knowledge.
edits.after: White papers and reports based on competition evidence.
edits.reason: The headline hides the publishing mechanism. The paragraph names white papers and reports based on evidence, with permissions retained.

edits.before: 把实测证据转为公共知识。
edits.after: 基于实测证据编写白皮书与报告。
edits.reason: 转为公共知识 hides the authors' action. The source explicitly describes co-authoring white papers and reports based on measured evidence.

edits.before: 让课程与实训连接真实交付。
edits.after: 用真实交付成果开展课程与实训。
edits.reason: 连接 does not describe the teaching method. The paragraph specifies courses and exercises using real artifacts and verifiable results.

edits.before: 支持赛事，也支持持续共建。
edits.reason: 持续共建 does not identify what is supported. Shared resources are named in the corresponding English text and following paragraph.
